title: Agents told to clean their scratch space cannot, because every removal command is refused
whatHappens: An agent over its scratch budget runs a cleanup; the command guard refuses rm, and scratch_status is missing in some sessions.

observations.text: Feedback: 8 reports from 3 agents, 10-30 16:57 to 10-31 10:56 UTC, in scratch, review and proof cleanup. No fix on main.
